create_ecapa_tdnn_model: create an ECAPA-TDNN model for speaker embedding with configurable channels, kernel sizes, and dilations
build_tdnn_block: build a time-delay neural network block with configurable kernel size, dilation, and group convolution
create_seres2net_block: build a TDNN-Res2Net-TDNN-SEBlock residual block with squeeze-and-excitation attention
create_attentive_statistics_pooling: build an attentive statistical pooling layer that computes mean and std with attention weighting
create_se_block: build a squeeze-and-excitation block that recalibrates channel-wise features via global pooling
